name: Holy Avenger

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +3 sword; an extra 2d10 Radiant against Fiends and Undead; you and allies near you have Advantage on saves against spells.
text: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage. While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates an aura in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures friendly to you in the aura have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the aura increases to a 30-foot Emanation.
